RH: THE REAL PART AND ONE BIT · MASTER v3.0.39_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 4 · RETRACTION, REGISTRATION AND THE LOSSLESS RECORD
Every point of every record lies on the line; the record of a record is the record;
Rec is idempotent and the record self-recursive. Every record carries least
erasure, and at the zeros the cargo loop delivers B′ with no premise. The Pause
